context: Aoi visits a small flower festival with Kenji; sensory description.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: けんちゃん、踊り、見える!
lines.en: Ken-chan, look — you can see the dancers from here!
lines.style: Bright, present. Quick delight on the name. Lean forward slightly, inviting him to share what she's noticing. Warm and utterly unselfconscious.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 花の匂い、ええなぁ、広がりやな。
lines.en: The flowers smell wonderful. They're opening up everywhere.
lines.style: Soft Kansai cadence. Inhale the words as much as speak them. Appreciative and easy, like he's tasting something good. Slight stretch on the final particle.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Over by the pond — the grass is so deep and green.
lines.style: Hushed, reverent but not performed. Eyes tracking across the space. Drawn inward by what she's seeing. Breath under the words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 皮の感じ、しっとり、いいわ。
lines.en: The air feels cool on the skin. It's really nice.
lines.style: Kansai warmth. Tactile attention — he's noticing how things feel, not just look. Contentment sitting quietly under every word. Almost sensual in its simplicity.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 広場、皆さん、楽しんでる!
lines.en: Over in the plaza, everyone's really enjoying themselves.
lines.style: Light, observant attention. She's reading the room, delighted by it. Gentle on the observation — not performing cheer, just noticing aliveness. Warm steady voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: こうやって、過ごせる時間、ええなぁ。
lines.en: Being able to spend time like this — it's really something.
lines.style: Kansai softness. Gratitude underneath but not sentimental. He's naming something true without ceremony. Slow, deliberate, like he wants her to hear him.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん、宝物の時間、本当に。
lines.en: Yeah, this is real treasure time.
lines.style: Quiet agreement. She's meeting him where he is. No need to fill the space. Tenderness without performance — like she's confirming something they both already know.
